s: Tobit, a devout Israelite in exile in Nineveh, gives alms and buries the dead at great risk.
Tobit is blinded and grows poor, and his wife reproaches him.
Tobit and Sarah, a young woman whose seven husbands have died, both pray to God, and God sends the angel Raphael to help them.
Tobit gives his son Tobiah wise advice about almsgiving and honouring his mother.
Tobiah finds a guide for his journey, not knowing he is the angel Raphael.
On the journey Tobiah catches a fish, and the angel tells him how its parts will heal.
Tobiah comes to Raguel's house and asks to marry Sarah.
Tobiah and Sarah pray together on their wedding night, and the demon is driven away.
Raphael goes to collect the money owed to Tobit.
Tobit and his wife Anna worry about their son. Tobiah sets out for home.
Tobiah returns and heals his father's blindness.
Raphael reveals that he is one of the seven angels before God, and that prayer with fasting and almsgiving is good.
Tobit's song of praise and his vision of a glorious Jerusalem.
Tobit's last words and death. Tobiah moves his family away from Nineveh before its fall.

12: Tobiah's travelling companion was an angel all along. God had been caring for the family through every step.
